name: droid-console
description: Restyles Claude Code to match Herdr's Jedi Archives and Sith Citadel layouts: Claude Code's theme, side palettes, Herdr's droid voices, spinner words and a status band. /droid switches personality.

matchTheme.title: Match Claude Code's theme to Herdr
matchTheme.description: Inside Herdr, switch Claude Code's theme to light-ansi (Jedi) or dark-ansi (Sith) so it uses the layout's colors; your own theme comes back in the next session outside Herdr.
